CHOICE: NONE
CONFIDENCE: 2

I could not verify any of the three answers. Solution 1 claims the answer is infinity, but its cycle argument is a sketch with an unjustified log lower bound on spread, and its table of "best max spread" values is asserted rather than derived. Solution 2 argues that the answer is 1, but its grid argument for c = 1 and its construction for c > 1 are both hand-waved. Solution 3 gives 3 but relies on a citation I can't confirm and offers no argument. I believe the true answer is a specific threshold from the literature on tree decompositions with bounded spread, but I don't reliably recall its value, so I'm not choosing any of the three.
